title: HungerMaster
description: A plugin to add a /food command with options
body:
This is a simple plugin to add a `/food` command with options - There are 3 subcommands: `add`, `sub` and `set` to give different options for adding, subtracting and setting food, rather than just the typical `set` provided by most feed plugins.

- Usage: `/food [target]` - Permission: `hungermaster.command`

- Tab autocomplete has been implemented
